about_the_game:
Build, Manage, Evolve!

Immerse yourself in a deep city-building strategy game where your settlement embarks on a journey from primitive shelters in the Stone Age to a thriving modern metropolis. Carefully manage resources, research new technologies, and adapt to evolving challenges to build a prosperous civilization.

Key Features:

• Settlement Evolution – Start with a small tribe and guide it through centuries of progress.

• Dynamic Economy – Every resource matters, and production chains evolve as your city grows.

• Logistics & Transportation – Organize resource delivery from carts and caravans to trains and trucks.

• Construction System – Buildings are constructed in stages, requiring materials and workers.

• Territorial Expansion – Compete for land, expand borders, and connect cities through infrastructure.

Will your city stand the test of time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-4350 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)
